explainer: Read-only planning overlay for deciding whether an official governance update is appropriate.
how_it_works: The overlay audits validation and approval evidence, then recommends handoff or official governance protocol without editing governance.
risks: A domain-specific rule may be copied into a general prompt without clear trigger conditions.
An overlay may be treated as active governance even though it is only a reusable prompt template.
mitigations: Each overlay template requires trigger and non-trigger conditions.
Each overlay states that it does not modify source code, runtime behavior, or active governance.
example_usage: Copy this overlay template, replace adaptation variables, and present it to an AI together with the general project prompt stack when the task matches the trigger conditions.
